Dear Nuclivision team,

I am writing to apply for the Marketing & Communications Specialist role. What caught my attention is that NUCLARITY is a CE-marked medical device used in clinical practice, and you need someone who can turn clinical evidence into content that a specialised audience actually reads. That is exactly the kind of work I do: at Episto I built ~600 member profile pages for a pharmacists' association, and for a kids' bike brand I ran a self-funded Google Ads test that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks by choosing buyer-intent keywords and building two Dutch landing pages.

I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I have my own car, so the trip to your Ghent office is no problem.

In the first weeks I would map your editorial calendar, audit the website and HubSpot, and draft a case study from a customer interview. I would welcome a conversation about how I can help you launch the new product and enter new markets.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Nuclivision team,

When I read that NUCLARITY is a CE-marked deep learning platform for PET image enhancement, used in clinical practice in Belgium and Germany, I knew I had to write. You are looking for someone who can read clinical papers, check every claim against its source, and turn complex medtech into content that a specialised audience values. That is the work I do now: at Episto I built ~600 member profile pages for a pharmacists' association on one consistent layout, and for a kids' bike brand I ran a self-funded Google Ads test that earned a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks by choosing buyer-intent keywords and building two Dutch landing pages.

I am a digital marketer with a sales mindset. At Episto I help client businesses rank for the searches their buyers make, from keyword research and technical SEO to local SEO and link building. As a freelancer I bring in and scope my own clients, including a construction company I brought in through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal covering the website, Google Business Profile, regional Google Ads and social media. My start in front-end development means I can build a landing page, run a Google Ads campaign and read the data without waiting on anyone. Outside client work I build my own products with AI, from a dog-care app on Google Play to fitness and nutrition trackers, which keeps me close to how real users find, try and stick with a product.

I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Ghent office is no problem.

In the first weeks I would map your editorial calendar, audit the website and HubSpot, and draft a case study from a customer interview. I would welcome a conversation about how I can help you launch the new product and enter new markets.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
